# GitHub Copilot CLI read-only adapter fixtures

- `copilot_stage0_small.jsonl` is the first 15 complete events of `Resources/Fixtures/stage0/agents/copilot/small.jsonl` from https://github.com/jazzyalex/agent-sessions at `ab439f13211e56b809f4a917d5c38e80d2bb5258`. Later redacted schema examples with placeholder timestamps/IDs were intentionally not copied. The fixture and parser mapping rules are MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Alexander Malakhov (`LICENSE.agent-sessions`).
- Official envelope/field verification: https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk at `075f027363fc3b1e904d09370763731c3ecd2d88`, `nodejs/src/generated/session-events.ts` (MIT; `LICENSE.copilot-sdk`). The CLI distribution/documentation repository was checked at https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/tree/57dd2440141be0b7d6d628472890f861e3b3ca55; it does not expose the CLI runtime implementation and no proprietary CLI code is copied.

Configured root is `~/.copilot` (custom paths supported by AgentVault). Current `session-state/<sessionId>/events.jsonl` and legacy `session-state/<sessionId>.jsonl` layouts are accepted. Persistence header `session.start` version **1** is supported; unknown versions, broken JSON, duplicate event IDs, mismatched session identity and incomplete lines fail visibly. User text uses `data.content`, never transformed model context. Tool starts are deduplicated against assistant tool requests; results/reasoning/metadata stay outside ordinary conversation text. Sub-agent and ephemeral events, skill/agent injected user prompts and autopilot continuations are metadata. Unknown event kinds remain visible in raw metadata instead of becoming conversation text.

The projection is the persisted chronological history, not a reconstruction of the current compacted model context. Files already rewritten by CLI rewind are reread. Attachments and workspace YAML are not dereferenced. Titles come from persisted `session.title_changed`, falling back to first user text. Reads are capped at 128 MiB with cancellation checks. No VS Code Copilot Chat, resume, delete or write support is added.
